user.title: Trelleborg Avfall
user.description: Enter the customer number (kundnummer) and personal number from your invoice from Kretslopp och vatten. Note that the portal locks the login after three failed attempts.

data_description.identification_number: 12 digits (YYYYMMDDXXXX), or an organisation number prefixed with 00.
data_description.street_address: Only needed when your account has more than one property.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Trelleborg again
reauth_confirm.description: The portal no longer accepts the stored credentials.

error.invalid_auth: The combination of customer number and personal/organisation number was not found. Check both values before trying again - the portal locks the login after three failed attempts.
error.no_building: The account has no property with waste collection.
error.building_not_found: No property on the account matched the given street address, or several did. Available properties: {buildings}
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the customer portal. Try again later.

init.title: Update interval
init.description: How often the pickup days are fetched from the portal. Pickup days change rarely, so a long interval is fine and gentle on the portal.
